sculpt_rock_outcrop.author: sculpted for this project
sculpt_rock_outcrop.notes: Sculpted world rock (rock_outcrop). Every LOD vertex coloured: COLOR_0 RGBA, RGB = neutral stone value (multiply by the land / instance tint), A = moss-here mask (aMix). No textures. Origin = foot centre, +Y up, ~1 m unit; scale per species. See .tmp/sculpt/rock_outcrop/INSTALL.md.
